name: New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets
region_note: WHO TO CONTACT ABOUT A BUSINESS: A PET SHOP, BREEDER, SHELTER OR RESCUE
notes: https://agriculture.ny.gov/animals/animal-related-complaints - two complaint forms. For a pet shop, breeder, shelter or rescue (how it cares for its animals, its premises, or its records): https://agriculture.ny.gov/animals/pet-dealer-and-shelter-rescue-complaint-form . For farm animals such as cattle, goats, sheep or pigs (someone buying, selling or rescuing them without a state permit, a disease the law says must be reported, or a broken quarantine): https://agriculture.ny.gov/form/domestic-animal-health-permit-bu . Not for cruelty: the state says cruelty is for local police.
section: Report animal abuse — WHO TO CONTACT ABOUT A BUSINESS: A PET SHOP, BREEDER, SHELTER OR RESCUE

change_log.note: Read on 2026-11-09: the page lists the pet dealer/shelter rescue complaint form and the Domestic Animal Health Permit business complaint form, and says animal cruelty is regulated at the municipal level and is not in the Department's jurisdiction. Both form pages load.
